At 5.15 pm Swamishri and his entourage departed by flight from Kolkata and arrived at Amdavad airport at 7.50 pm. At 8.25 pm Swamishri arrived in Gandhinagar and performed the pratishtha rituals of pujan and arti of the murtis of Akshar Purushottam Maharaj, Guru Parampara and Hanumanji and Ganapatji. Thereafter Swamishri was garlanded and briefly blessed the assembly of devotees.
Kanubhai Patel (CEO) phoned from America. He wished to ask for blessings today, on Pramukh Swami Maharaj's 90th birthday.
Kanubhai said, "Today I had your darshan (through the Aastha channel); at the start the sound was not clear, but I had darshan."
Swamishri said, "In that, dharma, knowledge, detachment and devotion are all included."

What was Pramukh Swami Maharaj doing today, on his birthday? Everyone wished that today he would do whatever he liked, but Swamishri was continuously busy in meetings. Also, phone calls kept coming from many devotees in India and abroad to convey birthday greetings and receive blessings. Even during the meeting, Swamishri was accepting everyone's feelings. And in between, he kept giving blessings and guidance by phone on problems in the lives of some devotees.
In this context Brahmvihari Swami said, "You have a special personality. The meeting goes on and in between phone calls keep coming, everything in the open."
Swamishri, looking lightly at his phone, said, "Things come through this too, don't they!"
Brahmvihari Swami said, "No office, no cupboard, no bag, nothing personal like 'This paper is mine, keep it.'"
Swamishri said, "Ours is a country style system; it will go on just like this. Just like this, by Maharaj's grace, the whole organisation has grown."
Former President Abdul Kalam phoned with birthday greetings.
Kalam Saheb said, "Namaskar! Today is your birthday; you have turned 90, so I pray to you that you stay on this earth until the earth completes 100 orbits of the sun, until you are 100 years of age."
Pramukh Swami Maharaj said, "Your feeling is also good. Good work keeps being done through you. That is my prayer to God."

Abdul Kalam said, "God will always keep your health good, because through you the lives of millions become meaningful. What joy and contentment the thousands of people who enter Akshardham every day experience because of you!"
Swamishri gave him blessings. It was already time for him to rest. The sadhus were standing around. Narayancharan Swami was helping Swamishri stand up.
Meanwhile Brahmvihari Swami said, "Just as Abdul Kalam said that the earth goes around the sun, so today let us go around you."
Hearing this, Yogicharan Swami said, "How can one go around Swamibapa?"
Brahmvihari Swami said, "Why?"
Yogicharan Swami said, "Who is capable of going around him? Akshardham has no measure, above or below."
Brahmvihari Swami said, "Still, let us go around."

Hearing this, Swamishri pointed to Yogicharan Swami and said, "Didn't he say, Aksharbrahma has no measure; he is on all four sides." Saying this, he began to make a gesture of turning his finger in all four directions.
Meanwhile Swamishri had stood up.
Yogicharan Swami said, "Just as Ganpati circled Shankar and Parvati, let us circle right here."

All the sadhus present began to go around Swamishri. Swamishri was reluctant. He tried to slip out of the circle. Narayancharan Swami tried to bring Swamishri back to the centre. The circling began. Some went around once, some one and a half times, some twice. Swamishri kept pushing forward. When the door came near, as he pushed to get close to it, he leaned to one side, but today everyone was getting a rare privilege. In this way everyone gained the privilege of circling Swamishri.
Former Chief Justice B. C. Patel, a member of the Human Rights Commission, phoned. Brahmvihari Swami said, "Since he heard the news of your illness, he prays every morning and evening."
Pramukh Swami Maharaj said, "It is well because of your prayers. Because you have devotion, God listens. In satsang too, women and men devotees are observing vows, austerities and fasts."
B. C. Patel Saheb said, "Bapa! If it were for someone else, one could recommend it to someone else, but for you one has to tell God himself, doesn't one! Only God is above you."

Just then a call came from Kampala in connection with the assembly of the golden jubilee celebration. He was to give blessings to the devotees. The call was connected three times and cut off; in between there were gaps in the connection. Thoroughness is Pramukh Swami Maharaj's virtue, so Swamishri kept asking with curiosity. So Brahmvihari Swami said to Swamishri, "Please relax; today is your birthday."

Swamishri said, "He is talking the European way. We finish things off together right where we sit; the European sits and when the time is up, he leaves. We finish it off together, however late it gets. On and on, work and more work. For us, relaxing is when the work is done."

ds.t: Where would we get other leaves?
w: In connection with Pramukh Swami Maharaj's birthday, Narayanmuni Swami said, "If you have any resolve today, please tell us."
Brahmvihari Swami said, "Just as Yogiji Maharaj said that in five hundred years everyone on the whole earth will chant Swaminarayan... Swaminarayan... The world will become Swaminarayan."
Swamishri said, "Since Yogiji Maharaj has said it, what need is there to talk of anything else?"
Gnaneshwar Swami said, "Gunatitanand Swami said that the name of Swaminarayan will be chanted on every leaf."
Brahmvihari Swami said, "Please say something new."

Swamishri said, "There is faith, isn't there! Swami himself has spoken of every leaf, so now where would we bring other leaves from? He is talking of other leaves!" In a single sentence Swamishri made a wonderful point.

At night Pramukh Swami Maharaj offered food to Thakorji. After the meal, the attendant sadhu read a letter written by Kishorbhai Bhuptani. He had written, "In the Gita, the month of Magshar is called a glory of the Lord, and according to the Rishi Samhita the month of Magshar is the morning of the devas. God recited the Gita to Arjun in the month of Magshar, so this month is also known as 'Dhananjay mas'. As stated in the Brahma Hansa dialogue in the Bharadwaj Samhita, feeding Brahmins has special importance. The ninth day that falls in the month of Magshar is known in the Vaishnav tradition as 'Jalebi Nom'. On this day Thakorji eats jalebis, so I humbly request that on the ninth day you and all the sadhus eat jalebis and accept our seva of providing the meal, and we offer the merit of this feeding at your feet, so that your health may always remain rosy."

This letter of request to Swamishri had been written in the context of tomorrow's fast of the sadhus. Swamishri accepted the request and had a call placed to him and gave him blessings of his pleasure.
The attendant sadhu said casually, "I have told Bapa that the sadhus will eat."
Swamishri at once corrected him: "Say that Thakorji will eat, not the sadhus; Thakorji eats."
Every moment, Swamishri is absorbed in Thakorji.
Doctor A. B. Mehta also phoned. After conveying birthday greetings, he said, "My wish is that you complete a hundred years and your centenary is celebrated."
Swamishri said, "Good. God will fulfil your wish."

Today after the morning puja, as Mahant Swami Maharaj was entering his residence, youths standing there said, "The abode of God, which cannot be attained in millions of ages, is attained just by joining one's hands to such a Sadhu." Saying this, they asked, "Swami! Akshardham is certain for all satsangis, isn't it?"
"Yes, since they have become satsangis, it is certain," Swamishri said.
Hearing this, everyone swayed with joy at the thought, "Nothing is lacking for me in any way, now that I have met Swami..."

Today, after accepting the welcome of all the satsangis of Silvassa, as Mahant Swami Maharaj was leaving the assembly hall, Snehmurtidas Swami supported him while he put on his sandals and said, "Swami! I had prayed to Swamibapa, 'Please keep holding my hand.' Then he had said, 'I will keep holding it, you do not let go...' Today I want to make the same prayer to you too: 'Please keep holding my hand.'"

While the sadhu was making this request, Swamishri was already holding Snehmurtidas Swami's hand. Hearing his words, he tightened his grip and said, "Swamibapa has not gone; I too will keep holding it. But you do not let go."
"Having taken hold of my arm, do not let go, O Giridhar; your resolve is unshakeable..." This title applies to Swamishri exactly.

Around this time, with the noble aim that young and old alike could benefit well from Bhagwan Swaminarayan's Vachanamrut and study every word of it in depth, the organisation had taken up a project for a "Vachanamrut application". In its final stage, about 11 sadhus involved in this project came to Mahant Swami Maharaj for some guidance.
In his conversation with them, expressing his wish, Swamishri said two or three times, "Aksharbrahma and Parabrahma are beyond maya. Put this point in again and again."
Swamishri took great interest in this spiritual discussion. So when the time came to finish it, he said, "I don't feel like finishing at all. I feel like listening to this night after night."

Bhagwan Swaminarayan says, "For me, there is never any time when my mind is satisfied with God's katha, kirtan, talks or meditation on God..." The reflection of this nature of Shriji is seen in Swamishri too.

ds.t: The glory of the Swaminarayan name
w: Today the Swaminarayan mahamantra was completing 216 years. So after his puja, showering his blessings, Mahant Swami Maharaj said:

"A disciple, pleased, said to his guru, 'I told a person to chant the name of Ram and his wishes were fulfilled.' The guru, annoyed, said, 'You owl's child, the name of Ram is for crossing the ocean of worldly life, not for such work.' We should have such faith. Chant the name from the depths of the heart, deeply. Chanting the name even once can bring moksha. What cannot happen through the name Swaminarayan? If there is faith, the chanting goes on constantly, one does not even have to be told. Just as when money is lying in the bank, whenever one is free one keeps counting it and thinks of it constantly, in the same way, if one understands the glory of the Swaminarayan name, the chanting goes on constantly.

A mouse kept jumping near the stove. When they dug three feet, 8 rupees came out. So much intoxication over 8 rupees! We do not have faith worth even 5 rupees. If there is faith, grand work gets done, the work of moksha gets done."
